About.desc: Next Meteo is a modern, high-performance, and minimalist weather web application built with Next.js. Developed as a hobby project
About.privacy: Next Meteo is GDPR-compliant by design: it features zero tracking, zero analytics, zero server-side data storage, and uses local storage strictly for user-requested functional preferences.

Privacy.title: Privacy Policy for Next Meteo
Privacy.intro: Thank you for using Next Meteo. Your privacy is extremely important to us. This Privacy Policy explains how we handle your information when you use our web application.

section1.title: 1. No Personal Data Collection
section1.p1: Next Meteo is built as a minimalist, privacy-first hobby project. We do not collect, store, or share any personal data.
section1.li1: We do not have user accounts.
section1.li2: We do not track your search history.
section1.li3: We do not collect your IP address or device identifiers.

section2.title: 2. Geolocation Data
section2.p1: If you use the "Current Location" feature, the app requests access to your device's geographical coordinates via the browser's native Geolocation API.
section2.li1: This data is processed purely on the client side (your device) to fetch the weather for your current area.
section2.li2: Your location coordinates are sent directly to the weather provider (<link>Open-Meteo</link>) to retrieve the forecast.
section2.li3: We never store or log your location on any server.

section3.title: 3. Cookies and Local Storage
section3.p1: Next Meteo does not use tracking, advertising, or third-party analytics cookies. We only use local browser storage for essential, functional purposes:
section3.li1: Functional Cookies / LocalStorage: We use these solely to remember your UI preferences (such as Dark/Light theme, chosen temperature/wind units, and your "Favorite" bookmarked cities).
section3.li2: These settings remain strictly on your own device and are never transmitted to us.

section4.title: 4. Third-Party Services
section4.p1: Our app fetches meteorological data from Open-Meteo. When the app requests a forecast, your browser communicates directly with their API. Open-Meteo is a privacy-friendly service that does not track users or store personal data. You can review their policy here: Open-Meteo Privacy Policy.

section5.title: 5. Changes to This Policy
section5.p1: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect functional updates to the app. Any changes will be posted on this page with an updated "Last updated" date.
